deviations.summary: Mechanism decision: owner chose the etlp-faithful _history shadow (Option B) over a read-API-over-the-ledger projection (Option A), even though the config_audit ledger already stores full before/after snapshots — for mechanism symmetry with 2a + the PG-adapter (2c) shape + capturing un-audited (seed) versions.

Ontology is file-backed (PUT /v1/ontology writes a working-copy + a target.type='ontology' audit record) — it has NO table to shadow, so its _history is the ledger projection (ledger_history). agent/judge (table-backed) get the shadow. The asymmetry is inherent to the storage, surfaced + documented.
